notes: New Shared recordings button: browse videos in your chosen NAS/local/USB folder, including recordings from other devices. Share a USB recording folder over your home network; other GreenStreem devices can find it automatically and pair once with a six-digit code. Saved connections, playback seeking, colored buttons, and address fallback included. Keep the USB-sharing device powered on and storage connected while others watch. Shared browsing is read-only; existing recording delete controls remain available.
